name: QTT Webhook Event
description: SaaS lifecycle Phase D — the idempotency ledger for gateway-delivered SUBSCRIPTION lifecycle events (Razorpay's subscription.* webhooks), keyed on the gateway's own per-delivery event id (Razorpay: the X-Razorpay-Event-Id header, confirmed unique-per-event against Razorpay's own webhook documentation). Deliberately separate from QTT Payment Transaction, which remains the idempotency mechanism for the existing Orders/one-time-payment webhook flow, unchanged — a subscription lifecycle event (e.g. subscription.halted) often has no payment at all, so reusing a payment-shaped doctype for it would be a conflation, not a reuse. Insert-then-catch-UniqueValidationError-on (gateway, gateway_event_id) is the same concurrency-safe pattern already established by QTT Tenant Product Subscription Pointer. Fully locked down — no role, including System Manager, can create/edit/delete a row through the Desk UI; every write goes through qtt_platform.billing.service, mirroring QTT Payment Transaction's own trust boundary.

fields.label: Gateway
fields.description: e.g. 'razorpay' — matches QTT Payment Gateway Config.gateway_key.

fields.label: Gateway Event ID
fields.description: The gateway's own per-delivery event identifier (Razorpay: X-Razorpay-Event-Id header) — the webhook idempotency key for this ledger. A redelivered webhook with the same id fails this doctype's own database-level unique constraint, which is what makes reprocessing a safe no-op rather than an application-level check alone.

fields.label: Event Type
fields.description: The gateway's own raw event name, e.g. 'subscription.activated' — free text, not a platform-defined enum, since the set of events a gateway may send is that gateway's own vocabulary, not this app's.

fields.label: Gateway Subscription ID
fields.description: Matches QTT Product Subscription.razorpay_subscription_id — for correlation/debugging, not itself a uniqueness key (a subscription has many events over its lifetime).

fields.label: Raw Payload
fields.description: The gateway's full webhook payload, kept for reconciliation and dispute debugging — same reasoning as QTT Payment Transaction.raw_payload.
